name: Projected Slabs Approximation
aliases: Projected Slabs Approximation for Perspective Volume Rendering
definition: An algorithm that approximates perspective volume rendering using parallel projected slabs to enable acceleration on hardware designed for parallel projection, with analytical error bounds.
summary: Projected Slabs Approximation renders perspective volume data by decomposing the view into parallel slabs, enabling hardware acceleration for orthographic projection while providing full volumetric compositing rather than scalar projections.
